what_happened.line: The Select Board approved a new three-year town manager contract, running July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2024.
The contract terms include a payout of unused vacation days, longer severance, deferred compensation, a higher phone allowance and three years of raises.
The board renewed six earth removal permits through August 2022, and held a change to Proctor's permit hours for a week after an abutter objected.
The town manager reported that the 30 School Street landscape architect RFP drew no proposals; it will return to a future agenda, likely with a changed timeline.
The board heard a cannabis retailer on its host community agreement and left the date of a community outreach meeting to the town manager.

why_it_matters: The town manager contract sets pay and severance terms for the town's top administrator for three years, which the town budget (mostly taxes) carries.
The unfilled 30 School Street design RFP means that project is delayed, and any new timeline or fee could come back as a budget request.
The cannabis host community agreement and the earth removal permits affect neighbors directly, and abutters can still comment before the Proctor vote.
watch_next: Aug 24, 2021: the Select Board's vote on the Proctor earth removal permit hours change, and the opening of the warrant for a special town meeting set for Nov 16, 2021.
The conservation boundary survey estimate, due on next week's agenda.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on six of the seven votes, and the contract, permit, survey and water-commitment figures match once caption errors are set aside. The main difference is the special town meeting vote: our captions could not hear the outcome, while the official minutes record it as passed. Our minutes also list a "Mr. O'Brien" as a member, and the official minutes show no such person.
